T: Up is down. Dinner is now.
D: Will, Elizabeth and Barbossa sail to the end of the world to bring Jack back from Davy Jones's Locker.
P: Serve the snacks when the Brethren Court gathers at Shipwreck Cove.
S: Pork and prawn dumplings steamed 8 minutes in bamboo baskets, with soy, black vinegar and chilli oil.
Jack and his single peanut in the Locker
Peanuts roasted with butter, honey and smoked salt at 180C for 10 minutes, cooled into crunchy clusters.
the crabs carrying the Pearl across the sand
Crab meat mixed with mayo, lemon and chives, piled onto toasted brioche rounds with a pinch of paprika.
M: Crab cooked in a sticky sweet chilli tomato sauce with egg ribbons, eaten with bread to mop up.
Will and Elizabeth getting married in the middle of the battle
Snapper fillets pan-fried with lime butter and capers, with coconut rice and a mango salad.
W: the green flash at sunset as Will goes back to the sea
Coconut milk, sugar and pandan paste whisked with cornflour over low heat until thick, poured into glasses and chilled 3 hours, topped with toasted coconut and mango.
K: Gin, cherry liqueur, pineapple and lime with a dash of grenadine, tall and pink. Shake 30ml gin, 15ml cherry liqueur, 90ml pineapple juice, 15ml lime juice and a dash of grenadine with ice.

s.how: Mix 250g pork mince with 150g chopped green prawns, soy and salt. Fill dumpling wrappers and pleat closed. Steam in a lined bamboo basket for 8 minutes. Serve with small dishes of soy sauce, black vinegar and chilli oil for dipping.

s.note: Jack and his single peanut in the Locker
s.how: Melt 30g butter with 3 tbsp honey and toss through 300g peanuts with a pinch of smoked salt. Spread on a lined tray and roast at 180C for 10 minutes, stirring once. Cool until crunchy, then break into clusters. A snack fit for a captain in a strange place.

m.how: Fry 3 garlic cloves, ginger and 2 chillies, add 150ml tomato sauce, 3 tbsp sweet chilli, 1 tbsp soy and 250ml water. Add 1.5kg cleaned crab pieces, cover and cook 10 minutes. Stir in 2 beaten eggs and serve with crusty bread.

w.note: the green flash at sunset as Will goes back to the sea
w.how: Whisk 800ml coconut milk, 100g sugar, a teaspoon of pandan paste and 5 tbsp cornflour over low heat until thick and glossy. Pour into glasses and chill for 3 hours. Top with toasted shredded coconut and diced mango. Watch for the green flash.

d.how: Shake 30ml gin, 15ml cherry liqueur, 90ml pineapple juice, 15ml lime juice and a dash of grenadine with ice. Strain into 4 tall ice-filled glasses.
